title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
summary: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero TechCrunch
body: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero TechCrunch
summaryZh: 英伟达的相关研究揭示，在评估AI系统表现时，外围的管理框架（harness）扮演了比基础大模型更为关键的角色。原始信息显示：Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero TechCrunch。该消息由TechCrunch发布，主题为“Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero”。其重要性主要体现在：TechCrunch报道指出英伟达研究显示外围封装框架（harness）是提升AI效能的关键。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
